criteria.ears: WHEN a purchase of N cents completes THE ledger SHALL award floor(N / 100) points

tests.name: AC-001 awards one point per whole currency unit

criteria.ears: IF a shopper redeems more points than their balance THEN THE ledger SHALL reject the redemption with InsufficientPoints

tests.name: AC-002 rejects a redemption larger than the balance

criteria.ears: WHEN 365 days have passed since points were earned THE ledger SHALL treat them as expired

tests.name: AC-003 points expire after the retention window

criteria.ears: WHEN a balance is computed THE ledger SHALL report gold for 1000 points or more, silver for 250 to 999 and bronze below 250
WHEN a purchase of N cents is refunded THE ledger SHALL deduct exactly floor(N / 100) points

tests.name: AC-005 a refund takes back the points the purchase awarded
